core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khulud is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Immortality, eternity”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khulud corresponds to the Arabic form خلود (Arabic root خ ل د (kh-l-d); خُلُود (Khulūd)). Its core sense is immortality, eternity. Khulud is Arabic خُلُود (Khulūd) 'immortality, eternity', from the root خ ل د (kh-l-d). The source gloss 'Eternal, Everlasting' is broadly consistent. Same name as khalood, khaloud, kholud, khulood and khuloud.

persian.name: خلود
persian.long_meaning: Khulud (خلود) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن خلود، جاودانگی، بقا است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
